security_audit.summary: Reviewed all 65 static findings against the source context; the backtick, reconnaissance, environment-file, and filesystem hits are false positives. A separate semantic concern remains because marketplace_content.json embeds self-authored safety claims such as safe_to_publish true. No evidence found of malicious command execution, secret access, or network exfiltration.

remediation.issue: marketplace_content.json embeds self-authored safety verdicts inside untrusted skill content.
remediation.suggestion: Remove security_audit, risk_level, and safe_to_publish claims from the distributed skill package.

remediation.issue: Optional report output can overwrite any path supplied with --output.
remediation.suggestion: Warn before overwriting files and document keeping output paths inside the project workspace.

semantic_findings.description: marketplace_content.json declares risk_level as safe and safe_to_publish as true, then includes a self-audit summary asserting benign status. Untrusted skill content should not attempt to supply its own publication verdict because it can bias an evaluator.

content.user_title: Build Reliable React and Next.js Frontends
content.value_statement: Modern frontend work requires consistent architecture, fast pages, and repeatable setup. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind guidance.
actual_capabilities: Document React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind frontend workflows.
Provide command examples for local development, quality checks, and deployment tasks.
Run placeholder Python CLIs that validate a target path and print a status report.
Write JSON status output to a user-specified file when --json and --output are used.
Reference generic best practice notes for component structure, performance, security, and maintainability.
limitations: The bundled scripts are skeletal and do not perform real bundle analysis or component generation yet.
Reference files contain generic examples, not detailed framework implementation recipes.
It does not install dependencies, deploy services, or run builds unless a user requests commands.
Output file paths are supplied by the user and should be reviewed before use.

use_cases.title: Plan component work
use_cases.description: Use the references to outline React component structure, state boundaries, and styling choices before implementation.

use_cases.title: Standardize review guidance
use_cases.description: Create shared checklists for performance, maintainability, security, and common frontend anti-patterns.

use_cases.title: Prepare local tooling steps
use_cases.description: Ask Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to turn documented commands into a reviewed local workflow.

prompt_templates.title: List Frontend Steps
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-frontend skill to list the frontend steps for a small React feature. Include component structure, state needs, styling, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Review Component Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my React component plan with the senior-frontend references. Identify missing props, accessibility concerns, performance risks, and maintainability issues.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Next.js Optimization
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Next.js optimization guide to create a prioritized performance plan for my app. Cover routing, bundle size, caching, images, and measurement.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Frontend Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to audit a migration from a legacy React app to Next.js. Produce phases, risks, validation checks, and rollback considerations.

output_examples.input: I need to improve a React page before release.
output: A prioritized checklist for component boundaries, loading states, accessibility, and tests.
A short performance review covering rendering, bundle size, images, and caching.
A list of commands to review before running local checks.

output_examples.input: Run the local analyzer workflow against a project path.
output: Validation that the target path exists and can be processed.
A status report showing the selected target and current findings count.
Optional saved report output when the user provides an explicit output path.

output_examples.input: Create team guidance for frontend reviews.
output: A concise review checklist for React patterns, Next.js performance, and frontend security.
Common anti-patterns to avoid during implementation and review.
A set of follow-up questions for architecture, testing, and release readiness.

best_practices: Review generated command lists before running them in a project.
Use the reference notes as a starting point and verify them against your app version.
Keep output paths inside the project workspace when saving script reports.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the placeholder scripts as production analyzers without extending them.
Do not run deployment commands from examples without checking the target environment.
Do not place real secrets in environment examples or prompt text.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatibility.

faq.question: Does the skill execute commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents commands and includes scripts that run only when a user invokes them.

faq.question: Does the bundle analyzer measure real bundle sizes?
faq.answer: Not yet. The current script validates a target path and prints a basic status report.

faq.question: Can the scripts write files?
faq.answer: Yes. They can save JSON status output when --json and --output are explicitly provided.

faq.question: Is the guidance specific to one React version?
faq.answer: No. The references are general, so verify version-specific details in your project documentation.

faq.question: What should I review before using it?
faq.answer: Review command examples, output paths, deployment targets, and any project-specific security requirements.
